- The same document confirms the wetland is formed at the mouth of the Huasco River, placing it 2–5 km from the town by road.  
  The article also situates the wetland east of the town, with the sea to the west and the Atacama Desert to the east, matching the directional description you provided.  
  The white‑sand beach you saw 5–7 km to the south lies along the coast adjacent to the wetland, though its name is not specified in the article.
